name: extract-go
cmd:
set +e
mkdir -p "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR"
printf '%s\n' 'bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null 2>&1 && . research/extract/go-setup.sh && cd core && bun test extract-go.test.ts 2>&1' > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/command.txt"
( bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null 2>&1 && . research/extract/go-setup.sh && cd core && bun test extract-go.test.ts 2>&1 ) > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/native.log" 2>&1
code=$?
printf '{"exit":%s,"kind":"interactive diagnostic; not a strict gate"}\n' "$code" > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/COMMAND-RESULT.json"
exit "$code"

name: owned-lint
cmd:
set +e
mkdir -p "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR"
printf '%s\n' 'bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null 2>&1 && bunx oxlint --type-aware --deny-warnings --disable-nested-config core/extract-go.test.ts core/extract-rb.test.ts core/extract-ex.test.ts' > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/command.txt"
( bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null 2>&1 && bunx oxlint --type-aware --deny-warnings --disable-nested-config core/extract-go.test.ts core/extract-rb.test.ts core/extract-ex.test.ts ) > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/native.log" 2>&1
